review_method: Read-only review of validator logic, actual final exception records, exact native project seam settings and all layer/feature group checks. No thresholds changed by this review.
decision: Accept as explicitly bounded relocation of short intentional inner-wall seam gaps at FDM resolution. Full group/layer presence, bidirectional spatial coverage and near-zero net path length remain required; outer walls, infill and all other groups keep the strict comparison. This is tolerance-bounded toolpath equivalence, not bitwise path identity or physical strength qualification.
